name: argon.dodge_direction_forward
description: How much of the current Dodge points forward, from -1 (backward) to 1, or 0 when not dodging.

name: argon.dodge_direction_side
description: How much of the current Dodge points sideways, from -1 to 1, or 0 when not dodging.

name: argon.facing_block
description: Whether a block is within the given distance along the entity's line of sight.

arguments.description: How far to look, in blocks.

name: argon.item_energy
description: The energy stored in the item in the given slot, or 0 if there is none.

name: argon.item_energy_level
description: The stored energy of the item in a slot as a level: min_level at or below start, then one more level for every step of energy, up to max_level.

arguments.description: The energy at or below which the level is min_level.
How much energy each level above min_level takes.

name: argon.swing_arm_left
description: Whether the entity's left arm is swinging, counting offhand swings.

name: argon.swing_arm_right
description: Whether the entity's right arm is swinging, counting offhand swings (unlike palladium.attack_on_right_arm, which only follows the main hand).

name: argon.swing_arm_yaw
description: The body twist of the current swing in degrees, doubled like the vanilla arm yaw and signed for whichever arm is swinging, main hand or offhand.

name: argon.wall_crawl_roll
description: The roll, in degrees, of the body on the surface Wall Crawling is attached to, following where the entity looks. 0 when not on a surface.
